title: Unselected tape preservation
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\sigma$ embed the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and let $c$ be a configuration on $m$ tapes. For any initial contents and head positions on $k$ tapes, any output prefix, and any index $j$ outside the image of $\sigma$, the embedded configuration has tape $j$ equal to its given initial tape and head position equal to its given initial head position.
hypotheses_covered: Initial tape contents and head positions for the $k$ tapes
An output prefix and an $m$-tape configuration $c$
An index $j$ outside the image of $\sigma$
